name: Stonefield Farm
summary: The Stonefield family works the fields in southern Elwynn Forest. Their long feud with the neighboring Maclures keeps the two households at odds.

sections.title: A Bitter Homestead
sections.body: Stonefield Farm lies south of Goldshire, where the family grows crops for the realm. For decades, the Stonefields have quarreled with the nearby Maclure Vineyards. The households trade accusations of theft and trespassing, and even small disputes keep tensions high. Gramma Stonefield, Ma Stonefield, and young Tommy Joe Stonefield make their home here.

faq.q: What is the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures?
faq.answer: The Stonefields and Maclures have quarreled for years in southern Elwynn Forest. They accuse each other of trespassing, theft, and other wrongs, and refuse to cooperate even on simple neighborhood matters.
Gramma Stonefield, Ma Stonefield, and young Tommy Joe Stonefield live at the farm, which is managed by the Stonefield clan.

faq.q: What is Tommy Joe Stonefield's secret?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe Stonefield is secretly in love with Maybell Maclure, despite the hostility between their families. The two rely on sympathetic travelers to carry messages and gifts without their families noticing.

angles.text: As a human from Northshire, you can see the squabbles between the Stonefields and Maclures as a glimpse of rural life beyond the threat of bandits and gnolls.
